integrity: The proof constructs an explicit continuum-indexed antichain of nonzero equivalence classes using complete countable literal conjunctions. The recent primary paper was read at its language definition, Lindenbaum--Tarski construction, c.c.c. definition, almost-measurable definition, and modal-model definition. The related Durham thesis was inspected at the corresponding setup and c.c.c. passages. Candidate-specific database and literature searches found no source drawing the same all-kappa emptiness conclusion.
scientific_limitations: The obstruction applies to the framework with at least countably many independent propositional variables, countable conjunctions, the stated Lindenbaum--Tarski quotient, and the c.c.c. requirement. It does not select or analyze a repaired alternative framework.
title: Continuum antichain obstruction to almost-measurable countable-sentential models
